summary: Fixes stale release URLs and cached subsystem metadata by enforcing canonical routes, current asset cache keys and repository-wide release-token consistency.

checks.detail: All core JavaScript files pass syntax validation.
Control Center removes v, _platform_release and temporary _refresh parameters after startup.
The update action reloads the canonical route with an ephemeral cache-buster and never persists a release number in the URL.
All deployable HTML and JavaScript references use cache key 20260724.118.
No deployable file contains a release cache key older than the current package.
Manifest, Subsystem Registry and runtime module versions are aligned.
Complete replacement package; preserve only .git and images.
